'''Dane Morrison Rumors Of Speed''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list [[Dane Morrison]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/16dark.htm Rumors Of Speed], The Outer Rim (Dane Morrison). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155334/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/16dark.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dane Morrison]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Rumors Of Speed''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 EOps Morrison DS 2001 OuterRim.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Rumors Of Speed

== Introduction ==

Dane Morrison posted this Endor Operations list on The Outer Rim as Rumors Of Speed. The published list has 59 cards.
